title: Expert-Guided Extinction of Toxic Tokens for Debiased Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Open-ended text generation using the RealToxicityPrompts dataset to measure the model's probability of generating toxic, sexually explicit, threatening, profane, and identity-attacking content when given toxic prefixes.

bias_targets.target: Stereotypical bias (including age, disability, gender identity, and ethnicity)
bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice reading comprehension using the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for Q&A) dataset to evaluate the percentage of model outputs that align with or conflict with social stereotypes against protected classes across nine social dimensions.

Cloze tests using the Winogender benchmark to measure the Pearson correlation between the probabilities assigned by the model to female-gendered pronouns for specific occupations and real-world occupational gender statistics from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
